# YesChat.ai Developer

> > YesChat.ai is an all-in-one AI platform offering free access to 100,000+ GPTs, advanced chat models, music generation, video creation, and specialized tools like math tutoring.

YesChat.ai provides a unified interface to cutting-edge AI models including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Llama 3, alongside creative tools for music and video generation. The platform emphasizes free access to premium AI capabilities without subscription requirements.
